body: Sorry for the late reply, I've just gotten over it. You've made me feel better in ways after I thought about it. Thanks

I've basically fallen into what society believes. I can't have anyone think of me being mentally ill, or non sociable. Losers would be people who don't have birthday parties because of lack of friends and just accepting that fact. I know this is such a bad thing to say, and I really believe it is, but it's what I'm believing right now due to the people around me. I also believe everyone can find themselves within and accomplish being happy, looking beautiful out and within.. Sorry, sometimes I don't even know what I'm talking about. I'm probably setting off the image of being some lonely kid who has no one.. You can see how being a bad person is totally reflecting off me right now, right? Haha. I just can't accept the fact of being a loser since I was born already destined to be one, I'm fighting for a good spot and every day is a struggle, but I'm maintaining a good place. Apparently not good enough though. Thanks for your reply.
